//: Vite transpiles TS itself, so tsc is used only as a type checker (noEmit).
`npm run typecheck` is the CI gate; `vite build` does not type-check.
noImplicitAny is enabled here rather than in tsconfig.base.json because the
base is shared with desktop/, which has not been assessed. server/ sets the
same flag in its own config. strict, strictNullChecks and allowJs are
deliberately still off — see CLAUDE.md for the measured counts.
